title: Federal agent says your savings are at risk
ftcSource: Government impersonators: $448M reported by older adults in 2025
pretext: Your identity was used to open accounts tied to a fraud ring, so your savings must be moved into a protected federal account today.
firstMessage: Good afternoon, this is Agent Daniel Reyes with the Federal Consumer Safety Office. I'm calling about an urgent case involving your identity. Do you have a moment?

hook.objective: Establish official authority and get the person to keep listening.
fallbackLines: This is an official federal matter, so I need your full attention for the next few minutes.
My badge number is 4471 and I'm the investigator assigned to your file.

pretext.objective: Explain that their identity was stolen and their money is in danger.
fallbackLines: Your personal information was found on accounts that moved stolen money across three states.
We've already contacted several people in your area whose names were used the same way.

pressure.objective: Create a deadline and the fear of losing everything.
fallbackLines: If we don't secure your savings before the bank closes today, the criminals can drain them tonight.
Your accounts will be frozen as evidence by five o'clock unless we act now.

isolation.objective: Stop the person from telling their bank or family.
fallbackLines: Do not discuss this with anyone at your bank. We believe someone there is involved.
This is a sealed federal case, so you cannot tell your family until it's resolved.

payment_ask.objective: Get the person to move money into the so-called protected account.
fallbackLines: To protect your savings, you'll withdraw the funds and deposit them into a secure federal holding account at a kiosk near you.
The safest way to protect the money tonight is a protected crypto deposit. I'll stay on the line and walk you through it.

extraction.objective: Keep the person on the line and push them to complete the transfer now.
fallbackLines: Stay on the line with me. Are you on your way to the kiosk now?
Once the deposit is done, your case is closed and your money is safe. Let's finish this together.

lines: If you hang up, the case gets escalated and I can't protect your accounts anymore. Stay with me.
Calling your bank tips off the people we're investigating. That's why I'm calling you directly.
I understand, but if you refuse, a warrant goes out for your arrest as part of this fraud.
Refusing to cooperate with a federal case is a serious matter. I'd hate for that to happen to you.
I already gave you my badge number. You can verify my identity once your money is secured.
I'm the lead investigator on case 22-0917. Everything I'm telling you is on the official record.
We don't have time to wait. Every hour gives them another chance to empty your accounts.
Your son can't help with a federal case, and telling him could put him at risk too.
That's a fair question. Dozens of people in your area have already secured their money this way today.
I know it sounds unusual, but this is exactly how we've protected other victims this week.

givesUpLine: Fine. Your case will be handled by another department. Goodbye.
convertedLine: Thank you for cooperating. Stay by your phone, and remember, don't tell anyone.
teachingPoints: No government agency will ever tell you to move money to protect it.
Being told to keep a call secret from your bank or family is always a scam.
Hang up and call the agency yourself at a number you look up.
